_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::level_set#0. The rule (a standard level-set advection wants DIFFUSIVITY 0, and any diffusion changes the physics) is confirmed with the sign of the effect measured. The upstream deck levelset_gaussian_hill_pbc is a convection-DIFFUSION Gaussian hill whose MAT_scatra DIFFUSIVITY is deliberately non-zero and whose four pinned phi values include that smearing; setting DIFFUSIVITY to 0.0 fails all four, and at every pinned node the pure-advection value is ABOVE the diffused reference, i.e. the peak survives instead of spreading. 4C emits no warning of any kind -- the run completes, reaches 'Checking results of 4 tests' and just reports other numbers, which is why this is only visible against a reference. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep the upstream diffusivity. All four failures and the peak-higher count drop to 0, so the fixture must go red.
